emit_progs.description: If provided, write compiled `.pb` programs to this directory (e.g., `/tmp/mtail` for debugging). Optional.

log_dir.description: Top-level directory to recursively scan for log files. If `log_paths` is set, this is ignored.

log_paths.description: List of explicit paths to log files (supports globs via shell-style wildcards, e.g., `/var/log/nginx/*.log`). Each path is tailed independently.

programs_dir.description: Directory where mtail stores compiled programs (`.pb` files). Not usually changed.

progs.description: List of directories containing `.mtail` programs (metrics extraction logic). Programs are loaded at startup.

http_endpoint.description: HTTP address and port to serve the metrics UI and health endpoint (e.g., `":3903"`).

metrics_endpoint.description: Optional alternate HTTP endpoint to serve raw metrics in Prometheus text format (e.g., `"/metrics"` relative to `http_endpoint`).

max_tailer.description: Maximum number of concurrent log tailers (limits resource usage on systems with many log files).

no_labels_from_filename.description: Disable automatic label extraction from filenames (e.g., `app=web` from `web.log`). By default, enabled.

no_auto_labels.description: Disable automatic label extraction from log lines using regex capture groups. Requires explicit `label` directives in `.mtail` files.

labels.description: Static label key-value pairs applied to all metrics emitted by mtail (e.g., `{"instance": "prod-1", "service": "nginx"}`).

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g., `"UTC"`, `"America/New_York"`) to interpret timestamps in logs without explicit zone info.

verbose.description: Enable verbose/debug logging (useful for troubleshooting extraction logic).

dump_log_content.description: Log full line content in error messages (exposes PII; use only in controlled environments).

store_memory.description: Store metrics in memory (required for pushgateway or in-memory querying). Disable only if using external storage backends.

url.description: Pushgateway HTTP endpoint (e.g., `"http://pushgateway:9091"`). Required if pushgateway is enabled.
